content:
TOMISLAV MESARIĆ
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia | +385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Butcher with 9 years of experience in high-street and market butchery, including carcass breakdown, boning, trimming and portioning beef, pork and lamb. Completed a 3-year vocational butcher programme and holds HACCP basic food hygiene certification, renewed in 2024. Experienced in recording cold-chain temperature checks, advising customers on cuts and cooking times, and maintaining clean, safe counters and equipment.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante (family butcher shop), Zagreb | 2019–Present
- Break down 2–3 beef forequarters and 10–12 pork sides per week; bone, trim and portion meat for the counter.
- Make four kinds of fresh sausage—ćevapi, kobasice, chipolata and lamb merguez—using the shop’s own recipes.
- Record cold-room (0–4 °C) and display-counter temperature checks twice a day.
- Serve approximately 120 customers on a Saturday, advising on cuts and cooking times.
- Train two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning routines.

Counter Assistant | Tržnica Dolac meat hall stall, Zagreb | 2015–2019
- Served customers, weighed and priced orders, operated the till and completed cash-up.
- Cleaned and sanitised slicers, mincers and the counter at closing.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATES
Vocational Certificate: Butcher (3-year programme) | Food Trades School Zagreb | 2015
HACCP Basic Food Hygiene Certificate | 2021; renewed 2024

SKILLS
Carcass breakdown (beef, pork and lamb) | Boning and trimming | Meat portioning | Fresh sausage making | Knife sharpening | Mincer and bandsaw operation | Cold-chain temperature checks | HACCP food hygiene | Customer service and product advice | Cash handling

LANGUAGES
Croatian (native) | English (good) | German (basic)

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, clear, and credible CV for the role. It presents relevant butcher experience, measurable work volume, customer-service responsibilities, food-safety tasks, training experience, education, certification, and language skills. The reverse-chronological structure is easy to follow, and the quantified examples—such as processing 2–3 beef forequarters, 10–12 pork sides, and serving approximately 120 Saturday customers—give the experience useful impact. The content is professional and appropriately concise. A small opportunity remains to mirror the job description's wording more closely for cutting and counter work.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: ATS compatibility is high. The document uses conventional headings, readable text, standard employment entries, and keyword-rich descriptions including butcher, carcass breakdown, boning, trimming, portioning, fresh sausage making, HACCP, temperature checks, customer service, and meat-counter experience. It should have a high AI/ATS screening probability for this vacancy because the two mandatory requirements are explicit and supported by quantified experience. To improve keyword matching slightly, the CV could use the exact phrase "cut to order" and the job ad's wording "cut and portion fresh meat," where truthful. It should not add packaging or FIFO experience because those are not supported by the original candidate information.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: Alignment is excellent. The CV clearly shows completed butcher training, more than two years of meat-counter experience, and HACCP knowledge. It also matches the role's practical expectations: cutting and portioning meat, customer advice on cuts and cooking, temperature recording, hygiene, counter cleanliness, cash handling, and working during busy Saturdays. The customer-service and apprentice-training evidence supports FreshCart's emphasis on approachable, knowledgeable, reliable counter staff. The CV lists Zagreb, which is consistent with the named Zagreb-Jarun role. Forklift licence is not evidenced in the candidate information, so this nice-to-have is a gap rather than a document defect.
critique.improvement_instructions:
MINOR ATS/alignment enhancement: In the Professional Summary, revise the sentence beginning "Experienced in recording cold-chain temperature checks" so the summary also uses the supported phrase "cut to order." For example: "Experienced in cutting to order, recording cold-chain temperature checks, advising customers on cuts and cooking times, and maintaining clean, safe counters and equipment." This adds a truthful phrase from the original candidate information and improves alignment with the meat-counter duties.

MINOR keyword enhancement: In the Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante experience entry, change "bone, trim and portion meat for the counter" to "cut, bone, trim and portion meat for the service counter." This makes the supported cutting responsibility more explicit and uses terminology closer to the advertisement without claiming unsupported packaging or FIFO experience.

requirements.requirement: Completed butcher training or at least 2 years at a meat counter
